blurb: Guests ride premium motorized trikes on guided tours through Tulsa's iconic landmarks, murals, and cultural highlights. Tours include the T-Town Tour, Sunset Tour, and Trike Nights, each offering a unique perspective of the city. Multiple trike models are available, accommodating single riders and two passengers with varying weight limits.
